nodes.name: agent_behavior.md
nodes.summary: GitHub issue template for reporting unexpected agent output, wrong tool calls, broken prompt sections, or orchestration issues, with fields for agent type, exec mode, and reproduction steps.

nodes.name: bug_report.md
nodes.summary: GitHub issue template for reporting reproducible bugs, capturing description, reproduction steps, expected/actual behavior, environment, and logs.

nodes.name: config.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub issue template chooser configuration that disables blank issues and adds contact links to the project wiki, Discussions, and private security advisory reporting.

nodes.name: feature_request.md
nodes.summary: GitHub issue template for proposing new features or enhancements, covering problem/motivation, proposed solution, alternatives, and acceptance criteria.

nodes.name: performance_report.md
nodes.summary: GitHub issue template for reporting slowness, high CPU/memory usage, UI hangs, or agent latency issues, with fields for reproduction steps, observed impact, and profiling logs.

nodes.name: security_vulnerability.md
nodes.summary: GitHub issue template for low-severity security findings safe to discuss publicly, warning users to disclose sensitive vulnerabilities privately via Security Advisories instead.

nodes.name: translation_issue.md
nodes.summary: GitHub issue template for reporting missing, incorrect, or untranslated text across supported locales, capturing locale, issue type, location, and current/expected text.
